So here's a PixiTracker jam track! Cool application by Alexander Zolotov (A.K.A Nightradio) from warmplace.ru Check it -- http://www.warmplace.ru/soft/pixitracker/ Also available on Android (most nightradio software run on multiple platforms) (may run on your toaster!) Yep, Built this simple track in about 2 hours. No post FX on this one, just a simple native jam... because nuclear, because weeklybeats. The video output is also native from the PixiTracker software. / no post fx. Link to piximod file Next week is a colab with Hungee Funk ... My first Weeklybeats Colab for the year! - exciting
